[2026-08-12T20:11:47Z] Deprecation removal-readiness survey — summary (analysis record)
(migrated from childsafe-bizarre-lorikeet comment 11 — session-scoped analysis record; the full survey text is retained on that ticket's comment 11, and per-item cross-reference comments were posted on the tickets that acted on it)

Scope: "what was deprecated in prior releases that we can now remove?" Surveyed rebar._deprecations (the central registry), docs/ + CHANGELOG.md + release-notes.md + api-stability.md + migrations.md, ADR 0050, the tracker, and live origin/tickets store data (81,840 commits; 1,884 active SNAPSHOT blobs).

HEADLINE. Nothing with a recorded removal condition had met it. rebar is at 0.11.0; every scheduled deprecation carries remove_in="v1.0.0" (_deprecations.py:47), and docs/api-stability.md:30 adds an independent floor (an alias survives at least one minor release AFTER its replacement ships). The real lever is precedent, not schedule: release-notes.md:226/:249 record two completed pre-1.0 breaking passes that removed scheduled shims early by operator ruling. So the actionable question was "do we open a third pre-1.0 breaking window, and what goes in it?" — which is what the operator then did.

TIERS.
- Tier 1, ready now: the retired .gitattributes migration arm (init.py:600-616 + _RETIRED_GITATTRIBUTES_LINES at :69), ~15 LOC, permanently unreachable in this store. -> became task checked-unhelpful-tanager (e654-58e2-0d38-48c6), now CLOSED.
- Tier 2, new pre-1.0 window (operator call): (a) single-pass review public surfaces (CLI `rebar review`, lib rebar.llm.review_ticket, MCP review_ticket) — key scoping finding: the ENGINE _review_ticket_impl must STAY (three live internal consumers: _mcp_llm.py:92-95, llm/review_workflows.py:86, llm/evals/eval_solver.py:348), so removal deletes only three thin entry points; schemas/review_result.schema.json also stays. -> priceless-charred-fruitbat (97d4-3098-2fb6-4658), now CLOSED. (b) REBAR_LLM_MODEL / llm.model, a supersession by [tool.rebar.llm.model_classes], small. -> slowmotion-stricken-mare (6cc4-56f1-6cc6-4c7f), now CLOSED.
- Tier 3, blocked on a named condition: resolved_statuses keys — CRITICAL distinction, reconciler.resolved_statuses is LIVE (Jira Data Center adapter, settings.py:101 -> backend.py:303) and is NOT a removal candidate; only jira.resolved_statuses is inert. Hard-removal follow-up salted-growable-murrelet (f408-64ad-ee41-46b6) is deliberately blocked on operator sign-off. Also fastmcp/mcp 2.0 (epic bared-nickel-insect): premise corrected — standalone fastmcp is not a dependency at all; rebar uses the bundled mcp.server.fastmcp pinned mcp>=1.28.1,<2, and ADR 0050 explicitly REJECTED the standalone stack. Not a removal; a future forward migration with six hard-blocking import sites. Also the event-schema/reducer compat folds: NOT REMOVABLE essentially permanently (1,118/1,884 active snapshots hold creation_channel "unknown"; 265 lack file_impact_scope; 155 lack plan_review_phase) — removing any would silently mis-project ~1,100 tickets. One narrow cold-but-keep exception: the attestations fold-in inner body (_processors.py:727-735, reducer/_cache.py:99-106), 588 snapshots enter, zero fold.
- Tier 4, needs operator decision (deprecated by policy, no recorded condition): 4-digit/two-quad short-ID acceptance (_ids.py:53/:256) — no registry row, no window, effectively unexercised in identity-sensitive artifacts (60/60 recent trailers use the full canonical id); and the unregistered CLI compat aliases verify-authorship and bridge-status, which must be REGISTERED and announced before they are removable at all.

POSITIVE FINDING (registry hygiene). The deprecation registry is complete and trustworthy: warn_deprecated raises KeyError on an unregistered surface, and tests/unit/test_deprecation_registry.py source-scans for raw emissions bypassing it. The only warnings.warn in src/rebar outside _deprecations.py is an unknown-frontmatter-key warning. The survey's registry-derived inventory can therefore be treated as exhaustive for signalled surfaces.

RECOMMENDATION AS GIVEN: remove item 1 only on schedule; bank items 2 and 3 in a third pre-1.0 breaking window at v0.12.0; do not touch items 4-7; announce items 8-9 before removing.
